newsitem.title: USA: North Sea paper Brent slides in U.S. late trading.
newsitem.headline: North Sea paper Brent slides in U.S. late trading.

text.p: The North Sea Brent paper market slid lower as a slew of partial cargoes changed hands in late U.S. aftermarket trading on Tuesday trimming July values by as much as 12 cents a barrel, players said.
Over 200 lots were sold by a Wall Street player to other Wall Street players and a U.S. oil company at $19.90 a barrel or 12 cents below Tuesday's IPE close.
That same Wall Street house and another sold 200 and 100 lots at the IPE closing price of $20.02.
Partial cargoes was also closed at $19.95 and $19.92, as was a cargo sized 500-lot June/July spread trade at plus $0.02, traders said.
